title: Rhode unveils first matte blush in founder Hailey Bieber’s 30th birthday collection
summary: The e.l.f. Beauty-owned brand is launching a limited-edition navy capsule this month to mark founder Bieber’s 30th birthday, featuring Rhode’s first-ever matte blush Pocket Plush and first piece of wearable merchandise – an £148 Reversible Windbreaker
